name: Stone Garden of Khazarad
desc1: This huge, circular area is breathtakingly beautiful. Intricate
desc2: arrangements of polished, shining stones are placed artfully along the
desc3: path here. A crystal-clear waterfall rains down from high above,
desc4: flowing down onto a massive glistening crag and being carefully
desc5: diverted via a clever array of channels to various pools and ponds.
desc6: Set in the centre of the stone garden is the Speaker's Hall, a wide
desc7: platform on the crag which serves as a place for public address.
